description: Enforced field set and enums for a host-neutral, evidence-bound verdict record. Single source read by scripts/validate_verdict.py; the prose verdict-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (goal_ref non-empty; at least one criterion; a PASS criterion requires an evidence_ref; verdict ACHIEVED requires every criterion PASS; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts the PhyAgentOS 'evidence before verdict' contract (execution / evidence / verdict kept separate; advisories cannot replace criteria or evidence) to the FRR system's enforced-record model.
